name: Majd
source:
Kia's client.

[url=https://vndb.org/c3673]Ali's[/url] uncle. He is second in line for the throne. His nephew, who is third in line, is becoming very bothersome for him. He is planning to set up Ali to look like a homosexual, then reveal it to the mass media.
